description: Mineral pigments and semantic color tokens. Colour is classification or state, never decoration.

paper100.role: Warm archival paper ground. Canonical page background.

paper50.role: Lightest cream. Elevated surfaces, cards, inset highlights.

paper200.role: Darker cream. Sunken wells, image placeholders, table hover.

ink900.role: Charcoal ink. Primary text, heavy rules, pictogram stroke.

ink700.role: Deep oak tone. Strong secondary text, metadata labels.

ink500.role: Warm mineral gray. Secondary text, captions, hairlines.

moss900.role: Deepest forest green. Display headings on light paper.

moss700.role: Primary brand moss. Wordmark, OK status, active operations.

moss500.role: Restrained moss. Secondary ground tone, soft borders.

coral500.role: Terracotta accent. Rules, fills, badges, non-text graphic accents.

coral700.role: Dark terracotta. Error status and AA-compliant text on paper (>4.5:1).

slate500.role: Cool mountain stone. Technical neutral, ambient indicators.

sand500.role: Warm neutral mushroom body tone. Surface fills, cards.

bark700.role: Deep oak substrate brown. Infill blocks, inverted signage.

warning.role: Muted ochre caution pigment. Non-text use only (2.39:1 on paper).

warningText.role: Darkened ochre. Only sanctioned ochre text color (4.83:1 on paper).

mossTint.role: Moss tint on paper. OK banner ground.

rustTint.role: Coral tint on paper. Error banner ground.

coralTint.role: Coral tint on paper. Accent banner ground.

warningTint.role: Ochre tint on paper. Caution banner ground.

soilTint.role: Bark tint on paper. Neutral infill.

warningText.role: Darkened ochre for legal ochre text.

coralText.role: Darkened coral for legal coral text (4.5:1 on paper).
